content.summary: Session management mapping across OpenCode, Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, and Task tool subagents.

data.original_input: OpenCode has session resumption issues; map session flow across OpenCode → Vercel AI SDK → Claude Agent SDK, including Task tool subagents.

codebase_findings.details: Sessions are created via Session.create/createNext with Identifier.descending('session'), stored in Storage under ['session', projectID, sessionID]. Each session tracks parentID, depth, title, permissions, and timestamps. Child sessions increment depth and reference parentID.

Messages and parts are persisted in Storage under ['message', sessionID, messageID] and ['part', messageID, partID]. Session.messages streams stored history; SessionPrompt builds prompts from stored MessageV2 history and feeds LLM.stream. There is no provider-native session dependency for most models.

Vercel AI SDK uses provided message history; it does not manage sessions itself. OpenCode passes messages and providerOptions. For some providers, OpenCode sets promptCacheKey to the OpenCode sessionID, but no explicit sessionId is passed by default.

ClaudeAgentSDKLanguageModel reads providerOptions['claude-agent-sdk'].sessionId and defaults to 'default' when missing. It captures SDK session_id from system.init via translate-stream and stores it in ClaudeAgentSDKSessionStore (in-memory). Subsequent calls use sdkOptions.resume when a stored SDK session exists.

codebase_findings.topic: Claude Agent SDK tool bridge context
codebase_findings.details: OpenCode tools are exposed to the SDK via MCP. The tool bridge expects a valid OpenCode sessionID (ses_*) to resolve session/message context; otherwise it falls back to a minimal context. If sessionId is not passed to the SDK provider options, sessionID defaults to 'default' and tool calls are not linked to real OpenCode sessions.

Task tool creates a child OpenCode session (parentID = current sessionID) unless params.session_id is provided. It returns <task_metadata> with session_id in tool output and includes sessionId in tool metadata, but there is no central storage mapping from parent session to child session. Resumption depends on the caller passing session_id explicitly.
ACP session state is in-memory. loadSession/newSession create or load OpenCode sessions via the SDK and replay stored messages to rebuild state. No provider-native session mapping is stored here.

prior_art.notes: Tests show session_id is captured from system.init and stored in ClaudeAgentSDKSessionStore; store is in-memory and invalidates on model change.

patterns: OpenCode persists session state locally and reconstructs conversation history from Storage rather than relying on provider-native session state.
Claude Agent SDK relies on its own session_id + resume token, but OpenCode only maps it in-memory and depends on providerOptions.sessionId to scope the mapping.
Task tool subagent session continuity is manual: the session_id is emitted in tool output but not auto-resumed.
Tool-bridge session tracking depends on receiving a valid OpenCode sessionID; missing providerOptions sessionId causes fallback behavior.
raw_options: Pass OpenCode sessionID/messageID into claude-agent-sdk providerOptions to avoid default session key collisions.
Persist Claude Agent SDK session_id mapping in Storage keyed by OpenCode sessionID to survive restarts.
Automatically attach last Task subagent session_id when Task tool is called again.
Store parent→child session linkage explicitly in Session.Info or a new storage table for subagent resume.
Temporarily disable SDK resume and rely on OpenCode message history to avoid cross-session collisions.
Add diagnostics when tool-bridge receives a non-OpenCode sessionID (non ses_*), to surface mapping gaps.
